title: import
$comment: SOURCE pp. 6–7,30,35–36. APPROVED D-009: commit freezes dataset and queues inference proposal, never mutates canonical Twin before human approval. APPROVED D-043 (T-016): profile is null until profiling completes; preview holds the first rows' raw values keyed by source column name. T-017 (D-043 (c) APPROVED; D-070, D-071, D-072 APPROVED): mapping is the mapping a person confirmed (import-mapping.schema.json); saving one makes the next mapping_revision and the import VALIDATING until the import_validate job of that revision has read every row: VALIDATED when every row maps to a valid canonical event, AWAITING_MAPPING with validation.valid false, invalid_rows and an error report otherwise; validation, invalid_rows, canonical_preview and the error report always describe the current mapping_revision.

status.description: UPLOADED, PROFILING (the import_profile job), AWAITING_MAPPING (profiled, or validated with invalid rows), VALIDATING (the import_validate job of mapping_revision is reading every row), VALIDATED (every row is valid under the current mapping; the canonical dataset is stored for commit), COMMITTED (T-018) or FAILED (final).

mapping_revision.description: How many mappings a person has saved: 0 before the first (D-071). Each saveImportMapping names the revision it expects and makes the next; validation results are only ever those of the current revision.

invalid_rows.description: Rows that are not valid: after profiling, CSV rows whose field count differs from the header's; after validation, the rows that do not map to a valid canonical event under the current mapping (D-072). 0 while VALIDATING.

items.description: UNTRUSTED_DATA (D-043): one source row's raw values keyed by source column name (member order is not significant: profile.columns gives the column order), the first rows of the file in order; CSV values are always strings, JSON event values are the raw JSON values. The server cuts string values (at any depth) longer than 256 characters to 255 characters and a final U+2026, and bounds the whole preview to 1 MiB, so it may hold fewer than 100 rows. A CSV row with too few fields lacks the missing columns; fields beyond the header are left out (the error report lists the row).

canonical_preview.description: UNTRUSTED_DATA (D-043 (b), D-072): the canonical events of the preview's rows under the current mapping, one per preview row in order (null for a row that is not valid), written with the validation; empty before it is done. Metadata strings are cut like the preview's (at most 256 characters), and the whole is bounded to 1 MiB, so it may hold fewer rows than the preview.

mapping.description: The mapping of the current mapping_revision, as a person confirmed it (D-043 (c)); null before the first save.

validation.description: The validation of the current mapping_revision (D-072), null before it is done: valid, and up to 100 issues, each with a typed code, a fixed message that never quotes the file, and a JSON Pointer into the file seen as an array of rows (/<row>/<source column>, or /<row> for the whole row, "" for the dataset). Every invalid row is in the error report.

Profile.description: D-043(a): the profile of the whole uploaded file, computed by the import_profile job. rows counts data rows (CSV records after the header, JSON events array elements; 0 for json_model). columns lists the source columns in file order: the CSV header, or the top-level member names of the JSON events in order of first appearance; empty for json_model.

ProfileColumn.description: One source column (D-043(a)). inferred is the one type all non-empty values share (integer and number together are number), empty when no value is non-empty, else mixed; JSON objects and arrays count as mixed. non_empty counts values that are present, not null and not the empty string; max_length is the longest value in characters (Unicode code points).
